breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science Term-III (English) — Geography Unit 1: Asia and Europe — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Asia is the largest and the most populous continent in the world. It covers about 30 percent of the world's land area and about 60 percent of the world's population. It spreads for an area of 44 million km2.

en.q: Asia covers about ______ of the world's land area and holds about 60 per cent of its population.
en.explanation: Asia spreads over about 44 million sq. km.

ta.q: ஆசியா உலக நிலப்பரப்பில் ஏறத்தாழ ______ பங்கை ஆக்கிரமித்து, உலக மக்கள்தொகையில் ஏறத்தாழ 60% கொண்டுள்ளது.
ta.explanation: ஆசியாவின் பரப்பு ஏறத்தாழ 44 மில்லியன் ச.கி.மீ.

questions.quote: Asia is surrounded by the Arctic Ocean in the north, Pacific Ocean in the east, Indian Ocean in the south. The Suez Canal separates Asia from Africa. The narrow Bering Strait separates Asia from North America.

en.q: The Suez Canal separates Asia from ______.
en.explanation: The narrow Bering Strait separates Asia from North America.

ta.explanation: பேரிங் நீர்ச்சந்தி ஆசியாவை வட அமெரிக்காவிலிருந்து பிரிக்கிறது.

questions.quote: The most extensive lowland in Asia is the Siberian plain. The central highlands stretch from Turkey to the Bering Strait. There are two knots found in Asia: 1. The Pamir Knot 2. The Armenian Knot.

en.q: The most extensive lowland in Asia is the ______ plain.
en.explanation: It extends from the Ural Mountains in the west to the Verkhoyansk Range in the east.

ta.explanation: இது மேற்கில் யூரல் மலை முதல் கிழக்கில் வெர்கோயான்ஸ்க் மலைத்தொடர் வரை பரவியுள்ளது.

questions.quote: Mt. Everest (8848 m) is not only the highest peak in Asia but also in the world. The lowest point in the world is located in Dead Sea in Asia. Tibet is called the 'Roof of the world' and it is also known as the third pole.

en.q: The lowest point in the world is located at the ______ in Asia.
en.explanation: Tibet is also called the 'third pole' because of its cold weather and largest reserve of freshwater.

ta.q: உலகின் மிகத் தாழ்வான இடம் ஆசியாவிலுள்ள ______ இல் உள்ளது.
ta.explanation: குளிர்ந்த வானிலை, அதிக நன்னீர் இருப்பதால் திபெத் 'மூன்றாம் துருவம்' எனப்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: A group of islands is called an archipelago. The largest archipelago is Indonesia. The Philippines, Japan islands and Indonesia are the major archipelagos in Asia.

en.q: A group of islands is called a(n) ______.
en.explanation: The largest archipelago is Indonesia.

ta.explanation: மிகப் பெரிய தீவுக்கூட்டம் இந்தோனேசியா.

questions.quote: The Ob, Yenisey and Lena are the major rivers that flow towards the north and drain into the Arctic Ocean. These rivers remain frozen during winter. Yangtze is the longest river in Asia.

en.q: The longest river in Asia is the ______.
en.explanation: The Three Gorges Dam has been built across the Yangtze; it is the largest power station dam in the world.

ta.explanation: யாங்ட்சியின் குறுக்கே மூன்று கணவாய் அணை கட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது.

questions.quote: The areas found in and around the equator have uniform climate throughout the year. There is no winter. The average temperature is 27°C and the mean rainfall is 1270 mm.

en.q: The average temperature in the equatorial regions of Asia is about ______.
en.explanation: The mean rainfall there is 1270 mm and there is no winter.

ta.q: ஆசியாவின் நிலநடுக்கோட்டுப் பகுதிகளின் சராசரி வெப்பநிலை ஏறத்தாழ ______.
ta.explanation: சராசரி மழை 1270 மி.மீ.; குளிர்காலம் இல்லை.

questions.quote: The major hot deserts are the Arabian (Saudi Arabia) and Thar (India and Pakistan) deserts. The cold deserts of Asia are Gobi and Taklamakan. The largest desert in Asia is the Arabian Desert.

en.q: Asia and Europe: Which of the following is a cold desert of Asia?
en.explanation: The Arabian and Thar are hot deserts; the Gobi and Taklamakan are cold deserts.

ta.explanation: அரேபியா, தார் வெப்பப் பாலைவனங்கள்; கோபி, தக்லமகான் குளிர் பாலைவனங்கள்.

questions.quote: Petroleum: The largest petroleum reserves are found in South West Asia. The important petroleum producing countries are Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Iran, Bahrain, Qatar and UAE. Rub-Al Khali desert is the largest, continuous sandy desert in the world. It is found in the southeastern part of Saudi Arabia.

en.q: The largest petroleum reserves of Asia are found in ______.
en.explanation: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Iran, Bahrain, Qatar and the UAE are major producers.

ta.q: ஆசியாவின் மிகப் பெரிய பெட்ரோலிய இருப்புகள் ______ காணப்படுகின்றன.
ta.explanation: சவுதி அரேபியா, குவைத், ஈரான், பஹ்ரைன், கத்தார், ஐக்கிய அரபு அமீரகம் முக்கிய உற்பத்தியாளர்கள்.

questions.quote: Iron Ore: Asia has the largest deposits of iron ore in the world. China and India are the important iron ore deposit countries. Coal: Asia has the largest deposits of coal in the world. China and India are the largest producers of coal in Asia.

en.q: China and India are the largest producers of ______ in Asia.
en.explanation: Asia has the largest deposits of coal and iron ore in the world.

ta.q: ஆசியாவில் சீனாவும் இந்தியாவும் அதிக அளவில் உற்பத்தி செய்யும் கனிமம் ______.
ta.explanation: உலகிலேயே அதிக இரும்புத்தாது, நிலக்கரி இருப்புகள் ஆசியாவில் உள்ளன.

questions.quote: Rice and Wheat are the staple food crops in Asia. China and India are the leading producers of rice in the world. Thailand is called the Rice bowl of South East Asia. The Banaue rice terraces were built 2000 year ago by the Ifugaos people in the Philippines.

en.q: Thailand is called the 'Rice Bowl' of ______.
options: West Asia around the Persian Gulf
en.explanation: The Banaue rice terraces in the Philippines were built 2000 years ago by the Ifugao people.

ta.explanation: பிலிப்பைன்ஸின் பனாவ் நெல் படிக்கட்டுகளை 2000 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன் இஃபுகாவோ மக்கள் அமைத்தனர்.

questions.quote: One third of the world's cotton is produced by Asia. India, Pakistan, China and Bangladesh are the leading producers of jute. Malaysia and Thailand are the leading producers of natural rubber. Among the countries Iran is the largest producer of dates in the world.

en.q: Which two Asian countries are the leading producers of natural rubber?
en.explanation: Rubber is a plantation crop of the tropical countries.

ta.q: இயற்கை ரப்பரை அதிகமாக உற்பத்தி செய்யும் இரு ஆசிய நாடுகள் எவை?
ta.explanation: ரப்பர் வெப்பமண்டலத் தோட்டப் பயிர்.

questions.quote: The Suez Canal route passes through the heart of the world trade route and connects Europe with South and Southeast Asia. Tokyo, Shanghai, Singapore, Hong Kong, Chennai, Mumbai, Karachi and Dubai are the important seaports in Asia.

en.q: The Suez Canal route connects Europe with ______ Asia.
en.explanation: Chennai and Mumbai are important seaports of Asia.

ta.q: சூயஸ் கால்வாய் வழி ஐரோப்பாவை ______ ஆசியாவுடன் இணைக்கிறது.
ta.explanation: சென்னை, மும்பை ஆசியாவின் முக்கியத் துறைமுகங்கள்.

questions.quote: Asia is the home land of three civilizations (Mesopotamian, Indus valley and Chinese civilizations). Among the seven wonders of the world, two are located in Asia (The Tajmahal in India, The Great wall of China). Ankorwat in Cambodia was built by king Suriya Varma II in 1100 AD (CE). 'Ankorwat' means 'the city of temples' in Khmer language.

en.q: 'Angkor Wat' in Cambodia means 'the city of temples' in the ______ language.
en.explanation: It was built by King Suryavarman II and is the largest Hindu temple in the world.

ta.q: கம்போடியாவின் 'அங்கோர் வாட்' என்பதற்கு ______ மொழியில் 'கோவில்களின் நகரம்' என்று பொருள்.
ta.explanation: இதை மன்னர் இரண்டாம் சூரியவர்மன் கட்டினார்; உலகின் மிகப் பெரிய இந்துக் கோவில்.

questions.quote: Europe is the sixth largest continent in size and the third largest in population in the world. It is the birth place of western civilizations (Roman and Greek), democracy and Industrial Revolution. The Prime Meridian 0º longitude passes through Greenwich in England.

en.q: The Prime Meridian (0° longitude) passes through ______ in England.
en.explanation: Europe is the sixth largest continent and third most populous.

ta.explanation: ஐரோப்பா பரப்பளவில் ஆறாவது பெரிய கண்டம்; மக்கள்தொகையில் மூன்றாவது.

questions.quote: The European Union (EU) is an economic and political union of 27 member countries. It has own flag and the common currency, the Euro (€).

en.q: The common currency of the European Union is the ______.
en.explanation: The EU is an economic and political union of 27 member countries.

ta.explanation: ஐரோப்பிய ஒன்றியம் 27 உறுப்பு நாடுகளைக் கொண்டது.

questions.quote: The Netherlands: About 25 percent of the Netherlands lies below sea level. So they have built dikes. These reclaimed lands are called polders. Fiord: A fjord is a narrow and deep sea inlet between steep cliffs.

en.q: Low-lying land reclaimed from the sea in the Netherlands is called a ______.
en.explanation: About 25 per cent of the Netherlands lies below sea level, so dikes have been built.

ta.explanation: நெதர்லாந்தின் ஏறத்தாழ 25% கடல்மட்டத்துக்குக் கீழே உள்ளதால் அணைகள் கட்டப்பட்டன.

questions.quote: The Pennines is called the backbone of England. The Meseta (Spain), The Central Massif and Jura (France), The Black forest (Germany) are important plateaus of Central Europe.

en.q: The ______ is called the backbone of England.
en.explanation: The Pennines are a plateau/highland in England.

ta.explanation: பென்னைன்ஸ் இங்கிலாந்தின் மலைநிலப் பகுதி.

questions.quote: The Pyrenees forms a natural boundary between Spain and France. The highest peak in Europe is Mt. Elburz (5645 m) in the Caucasus range. The Mont Blanc (4,807 m) found in the Alps. Mt. Etna, Mt. Vesuvius and Mt. Stromboli are the important volcanoes found in Europe. The Stromboli is called the 'light house of the Mediterranean'.

en.q: The volcano called the 'light house of the Mediterranean' is Mt. ______.
en.explanation: Etna, Vesuvius and Stromboli are the important volcanoes of Europe.

ta.explanation: எட்னா, வெசுவியஸ், ஸ்ட்ராம்போலி ஐரோப்பாவின் முக்கிய எரிமலைகள்.

questions.quote: The Matterhorn: The pyramid-shaped Matterhorn mountain is located in the Swiss Alps at a height of 4478 m. It is popular for its shape.

en.q: The pyramid-shaped Matterhorn mountain is located in the ______ Alps.
en.explanation: Its height is 4,478 m.

ta.q: பிரமிடு வடிவ மாட்டர்ஹார்ன் மலை ______ ஆல்ப்ஸில் உள்ளது.
ta.explanation: இதன் உயரம் 4,478 மீ.

questions.quote: Climate Divider: The Alps mountain separates the Mediterranean climate from the cold climate of the north.

en.q: The mountain range that separates the Mediterranean climate from the cold climate of the north in Europe is the ______.
en.explanation: The Mediterranean climate has warm summers and rainy winters.

ta.q: ஐரோப்பாவில் மத்தியத் தரைக்கடல் காலநிலையை வடக்கின் குளிர் காலநிலையிலிருந்து பிரிக்கும் மலை ______.
ta.explanation: மத்தியத் தரைக்கடல் காலநிலையில் கோடை வெப்பம், குளிர்காலத்தில் மழை.

questions.quote: Natural vegetation of Europe: Tundra, Taiga or Coniferous, Mixed Forest, Mediterranean Forest, Grassland. Eastern Europe is covered by grasslands (Steppe). Mediterranean trees like cypress, cork, oak, olive and cedar are found along the borders of the Mediterranean Sea.

en.q: The grasslands of Eastern Europe are called ______.
en.explanation: The Arctic and northern Scandinavian highland have tundra vegetation of lichens and mosses.

ta.explanation: ஆர்க்டிக், வட ஸ்காண்டிநேவிய மேட்டுநிலத்தில் லைக்கன், பாசி வகை டுந்திரா தாவரம் உள்ளது.

questions.quote: Wheat is the dominant crop throughout Europe. Viticulture is mostly practised in Italy, France and Germany.

en.q: Viticulture, the cultivation of grapevines, is mostly practised in Europe in ______.
en.explanation: Wheat is the dominant crop throughout Europe.

ta.q: திராட்சை வளர்ப்பு (Viticulture) ஐரோப்பாவில் பெரும்பாலும் ______ இல் நடைபெறுகிறது.
ta.explanation: ஐரோப்பா முழுவதும் கோதுமையே முதன்மைப் பயிர்.

questions.quote: Monaco has the highest density of population in Europe (26,105 persons / km2) as well as in the world. Iceland has a very low density of population (3 persons/ km2). Europe is the third most populous continent, after Asia and Africa. The population density in Europe is 34 persons / km2.

en.q: The country with the highest density of population in Europe is ______.
en.explanation: Monaco has 26,105 persons per sq. km.

ta.q: ஐரோப்பாவில் மக்கள் அடர்த்தி மிக அதிகமுள்ள நாடு ______.
ta.explanation: மொனாக்கோவில் ச.கி.மீ.க்கு 26,105 நபர்கள் வாழ்கின்றனர்.

questions.quote: Acropolis, the Colosseum, the statue of David, The thinker, Eiffel tower, Big Ben, Pisa Tower and Mona Lisa are some of the master pieces of art and architecture in Europe. Christmas, Easter, Good Friday, the Saint Day, Redentore, Tomatina and Carnival are the important festivals of Europe.

en.q: The Eiffel Tower is in ______.
en.explanation: Big Ben is in London; the Leaning Tower of Pisa is in Italy; the Acropolis is in Athens.

ta.explanation: பிக் பென் லண்டனில்; சாய்ந்த பைசா கோபுரம் இத்தாலியில்.
